name: db-connection-leak-p3
prompt: my service keeps exhausting the database connection pool under load, how do I find and stop the leak

chunks.content: record every admin action in an append-only audit log
cache the product catalog for 10 minutes and bust it on any write
decided to wrap every database session in a context manager so the connection is always released back to the pool even on error, which stopped the slow creep toward the connection cap
rebuilt the report layout with a responsive CSS grid
switched the dashboard to a dark theme using CSS custom properties
outbound email is pushed onto a background queue and sent by a worker
gate the new checkout flow behind a feature flag defaulting to off
enabled gzip compression on responses larger than 1 KB
the /healthz endpoint returns 200 once the database pool is ready
extracted all UI strings into a message catalog for translation
profiling found the image resizer leaks heap memory under load because it never frees the decoded bitmap buffer
switch the list endpoint to keyset pagination using the last seen id
the connection pool of swimmers at the public pool is exhausted on hot days, so the city added a second lane reservation system
added a gauge for checked-out connections versus pool size and saw it climb monotonically under load, confirming connections were being acquired but not freed
store all timestamps in UTC and convert in the UI
traced the pool exhaustion to a code path that opened a database connection inside a loop and never returned it to the pool when an exception was thrown partway through
